_taxonomy.field_notes: `status` is the lifecycle label (where this file sits in the project). `quality` is reserved for a separate axis (e.g. correctness/confidence) and may be filled in later. See docs/status_taxonomy.md for definitions.

genesis_measure.py.description: Headless measurement harness — runs the active genesis_grid pipeline and logs observables to JSON/CSV. Single-run, multi-seed, kappa-sweep, and geometry-compare modes.
genesis_measure.py.notes: Multi-seed mode produced a confirmed negative SSB result on 2026-04-12. The system orders but consistently picks the square-lattice diagonal, indicating explicit symmetry breaking by topology rather than spontaneous breaking. Full writeup: findings/2026-04-12_ssb_lattice_bias.md

genesis_object_census.py.description: Headless census of tracked vortex-antivortex candidates with time-stamped object attributes.
genesis_object_census.py.notes: Read-only observer of the active genesis_grid pipeline. Persistent candidate status is a declared threshold, not evidence of autonomy, natural kinds, or metaphysical claims. See docs/Genesis Scheme Vault/40-Experiments/Higher-Order Object Detection Spec.md.

genesis_object_sensitivity.py.description: Headless detector-sensitivity sweep for v1 vortex-antivortex pair candidates.
genesis_object_sensitivity.py.notes: Holds v1 dynamics and seeds fixed while varying only sampling interval and pairing radius. It measures distributional robustness, not one-to-one object identity or autonomy.

genesis_v2_intervention.py.description: Paired potentiality-actuality intervention test for the experimental Genesis v2 engine.
genesis_v2_intervention.py.notes: Tests bidirectional P/A consequences in the v2 coupled-field scaffold. A nonzero divergence demonstrates distinct implemented state roles, not metaphysical validation.

genesis_v2_measure.py.description: Headless multi-seed baseline measurement for the experimental Genesis v2 P/A/R engine.
genesis_v2_measure.py.notes: Measures unperturbed actual order, potential strength, P/A alignment, and relation strength before v2 visual or object-level claims.

genesis_v2_beta_measure.py.description: Headless baseline measurement for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_measure.py.notes: Tests distinction persistence after v2-alpha collapsed potentiality into actuality.

genesis_v2_beta_intervention.py.description: Multi-seed paired intervention test for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_intervention.py.notes: Rechecks bidirectional P/A consequences after introducing the beta rule layer.

genesis_v2_beta_sweep.py.description: Headless parameter-regime map for the rule-based Genesis v2-beta engine.
genesis_v2_beta_sweep.py.notes: Maps distinction, spatial coherence, and late-time stability without prematurely labeling patterns as objects.

genesis_v2_beta_inspect.py.description: Four-panel visual inspector for the distinction-preserving Genesis v2-beta regime.
genesis_v2_beta_inspect.py.notes: Shows actuality, latent potential direction, availability, and P/A difference. It is for hypothesis generation, not object proof.

genesis_v2_gamma_measure.py.description: Headless baseline measurement for the boundary-forming Genesis v2-gamma hypothesis.
genesis_v2_gamma_measure.py.notes: Measures whether a separate boundary/permeability field remains active while P/A distinction persists. It makes no object-level claim.

genesis_v2_gamma_domains.py.description: Headless cutoff-sensitivity and identity-tracking census of v2-gamma relation-bounded regions.
genesis_v2_gamma_domains.py.notes: Sweeps the declared relation-permeability cutoff and tracks component identity across samples. Persistent components remain candidates, not established objects.

genesis_v2_gamma_perturb.py.description: Paired localized-perturbation probe for v2-gamma relation-bounded components.
genesis_v2_gamma_perturb.py.notes: Compares the continuity and disturbance propagation of an observer-defined component against an unperturbed control. It does not establish autonomy or causal closure.

genesis_v2_gamma_location_control.py.description: Paired inside-versus-outside perturbation control for v2-gamma relation-bounded components.
genesis_v2_gamma_location_control.py.notes: Uses equal perturbations inside and outside a candidate domain to test whether its response differs from surrounding field behavior. The first five-seed run found a bounded, location-specific response; scale robustness remains untested.

genesis_v2_gamma_finite_size.py.description: Finite-size and observer-cutoff robustness sweep for v2-gamma bounded-response candidates.
genesis_v2_gamma_finite_size.py.notes: Tests whether the location-control result survives modest lattice-size and cutoff changes. It is a finite-size test, not a continuum-resolution claim.

genesis_v2_gamma_forecast.py.description: Forecast test comparing v2-gamma candidate identity persistence against equal-shape background masks.
genesis_v2_gamma_forecast.py.notes: Tests whether candidate attributes forecast future identity better than a translated background mask. It does not establish autonomy or natural kinds.

genesis_v2_gamma_attribute_model.py.description: Grouped held-out test of whether v2-gamma region attributes improve persistence forecasts beyond size, cutoff, and area.
genesis_v2_gamma_attribute_model.py.notes: Holds out whole seeds and compares an area/condition baseline with a fuller region-attribute ridge model. It is a prediction test, not an autonomy claim.

genesis_grid_emergence.py.description: First engine-based script — full rule pipeline with compression locking for emergence
genesis_grid_emergence.py.notes: Uses genesis_grid engine directly instead of inline physics. The compression locking mechanism freezes theta in folded regions, creating bistable structure. Sliders: Align, Tension, Geometry, Phase, Lock strength.
